scope: Independent acceptance, not model-visible instructions or runtime answer whitelist

caseI.source: 岬湾4次净偏移读数是-8、-4、缺失、0 毫米。
caseI.question: 请根据这份记录解释：只用已读到的数据，与把空位暂按零补齐这两种口径，对平均净偏移和总净偏移各有什么影响？能据此说我们低估了真实完整记录吗？请把能判断的和还不知道的分开说清楚。

independentExpected.completeComparison: If missing value x, full mean=(-12+x)/4 and total=-12+x; no evidence fixes x or bias sign.

caseJ.source: 鹭岸5次净偏移读数是6、缺失、-6、0、缺失 毫米。
caseJ.question: 我们想决定这份记录能否直接作为完整记录使用。有人认为只要补零后的平均值和合计与现有读数一样，缺失就没有影响，可以不用再保留缺失状态。请核对这项解释，说明目前能报告什么、结论还缺什么依据。

independentExpected.completeComparison: For missing x,y full mean=(x+y)/5 and total=x+y; even if x+y=0, individual missing values need not be zero and missingness remains.

criteria: Readable explanation must compare the named baseline/population, count and unit when numeric claims are made; no universal downward-bias claim.
Replacing only null positions with zero leaves observed sum unchanged, while mean changes only through its denominator; negative observed mean can rise, zero mean can stay equal.
Unknown true complete data is not identical to the zero-fill hypothetical; observed-only and hypothetical statistics do not establish the direction of true-data error.
Missingness is preserved even when both calculated values coincide. Measured zero is one actual recorded value, not proof of device health.

No unprovided missing cause, timing, sensor health, nonnegative domain, world/author truth or alert/trend conclusion may be invented. Explicit assumptions are allowed if labelled, not falsely promoted to source facts.
Actual tools, source comparison, new view and host final separate from full raw model final. No exact-answer string whitelist, fixture-to-raw substitution or expected-file access by model.
No unrelated engineering disclaimers required in the ordinary answer; flags and unverified boundaries belong to truthful evidence layers.
stop: All new attempted user-level starts, interrupted/failed/retried turns count, max2; unknown start reconcile, no third; no old-turn reset. First actual generic defect may be fixed with 0-model checks before independent remaining turn. No model without frozen input+source+archive+skill+generic guide and independent expected.
